result.title: CausalWAM: Learning the Causes of Actions in World Action Models
result.summary: World action models (WAMs) learn latent variables from observations and use these to both predict the evolution of the scene and to generate actions. The prediction has to be of the whole scene, whereas only a portion of the scene causes actions. WAMs fitted to demonstrations do not, in general, guarantee that they will generate actions solely from the latent causes of the demonstrated actions (the action-relevant latent variables), as the model could just as well learn to imitate in this way whilst entangling the action-relevant latent variables with the nuisance variables. We therefore separate out what causes action from what prediction depends on. We prove that under a sparsity constraint the latent variables used to generate actions are an invertible function of the action-relevant latent variables alone and the true structure is identified up to a permutation of the latent variables. This requires neither sufficient temporal dependence nor any assumptions on how the unobserved regimes evolve and holds even when the action-relevant latent variables are statistically dependent on the rest. We therefore propose CWAM (Causal WAM), which incorporates the constraint into a pretrained WAM by adding a sparse routing path to its action head, with the world modeling objective remaining unchanged. Experiments on both synthetic data and real-world robots validate the theory as well as showcase the improved efficiency in closed-loop success.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 world action model 中如何把真正驱动动作的因果 latent 与仅为场景预测服务的冗余变量分离：作者证明在稀疏约束下，生成动作所用的 latent 是 action-relevant latent 的可逆函数且结构可识别，并据此在预训练 WAM 的动作头上加一条稀疏路由路径（CWAM），在合成数据与真实机器人上验证理论与闭环成功率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用稀疏路由让输出端只依赖部分 latent、并给出可识别性论证，可供核查是否能迁移为 LVR 中检验「答案是否真正使用 latent 视觉内容」、抑制无关信息与做贡献分配的约束手段；但该工作面向机器人动作生成，与视觉推理状态的联系仍需人工判断。
